descriptor: A controlled review platform integrating Basecamp and human reviewers, with AI-assisted draft reviews.

requirements.statement: The system must detect a '##Critique##' marker in Basecamp comments, normalizing reasonable spacing and case variants.
The system must create a Review Queue item with status 'Pending' for each detected critique marker, tied to the exact submission/version.
The system must load only the rule module for the identified Stress Test (ST0) and never apply generic or incorrect rules.
The system must retrieve all necessary submission data from Basecamp, including comments, attachments, and links.
Claude must evaluate submissions against loaded rules, returning structured draft findings with rule ID, status, severity, evidence, reason, and confidence score.
Human reviewers must be able to approve, edit, reject, or add findings before final feedback is posted back to Basecamp.
The system must mark reviews as 'Completed' only after human review and Basecamp posting are both done.
The system must preserve the history of each review, including AI drafts and human edits, for audit purposes.
The system must route ambiguous project or Stress Test identifications to manual resolution rather than guessing.
The system must retry external API calls safely within a bounded number of attempts and surface visible errors if they fail.
The system must not auto-approve any submission; human review is mandatory.
The system must use Basecamp's OAuth 2.0 for authentication and authorization.
The system must connect to Microsoft SQL Server for data storage and retrieval.
The system must use Claude via the Anthropic API for AI evaluations.
The system must expose a typed API using FastAPI and Pydantic models.
The system must ensure that no credentials are stored in source code or shared documents.
The system must support adding new Stress Test modules (ST1–ST5) as configuration without rebuilding the core application.
The system must provide a web UI for reviewers to manage the Review Queue and perform reviews.

stories.title: Detect Critique Marker in Basecamp
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to detect critique markers in Basecamp comments, so that I can create review items.
acceptance: Given a Basecamp comment with '##Critique##', When the system processes the comment, Then a review item is created with status 'Pending'.
Given a comment with '## Review ##', When the system processes the comment, Then no review item is created.
Trust: The system logs the detection event with the exact comment ID.
failure_paths: Comment does not contain a valid marker
stories.task_guidance: Implement marker detection logic reading Basecamp_MessageBoards_MessageComments directly.

stories.title: Retrieve Submission Data from Basecamp
stories.narrative: As a reviewer, I want to retrieve all necessary submission data from Basecamp, so that I can perform a comprehensive review.
acceptance: Given a Basecamp project with submissions, when the system retrieves data, then it includes comments, attachments, and links.
Given a Basecamp project with no submissions, when the system attempts to retrieve data, then it returns an empty dataset.
Trust: The system logs all data retrieval actions with timestamps and user IDs.
stories.task_guidance: Use Basecamp API to fetch project data including comments, attachments, and links. Ensure OAuth tokens are securely managed.

stories.title: Load ST0 Rule Module
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to load the ST0 rule module, so that I can evaluate submissions correctly.
acceptance: Given a submission for ST0, When the system loads rules, Then only ST0 rules are loaded.
Given a submission for an unknown Stress Test, When the system loads rules, Then it routes to manual resolution.
Trust: The system logs rule loading events with rule version.
stories.task_guidance: Implement rule loading logic for ST0, ensuring correct module is loaded based on submission data.

stories.title: Evaluate Submission with Claude
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to evaluate submissions using Claude, so that I can generate draft findings.
acceptance: Given a valid submission, When Claude evaluates it, Then structured draft findings are returned.
Given an invalid submission, When Claude evaluates it, Then an error is returned.
Trust: The system logs evaluation events with submission ID and rule ID.
stories.task_guidance: Integrate Claude via Anthropic API, ensuring structured findings are returned for ST0 evaluations.

stories.title: Human Review of AI Findings
stories.narrative: As a human reviewer, I want to review AI findings, so that I can approve, edit, or reject them before posting feedback.
acceptance: Given AI findings, When a reviewer approves them, Then feedback is prepared for Basecamp posting.
Given AI findings, When a reviewer edits them, Then the edits are saved and prepared for posting.
Trust: The system logs all reviewer actions with timestamps.
stories.task_guidance: Develop a web UI for reviewers to manage and edit AI findings before final approval.

stories.title: Post Final Feedback to Basecamp
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to post final feedback to Basecamp, so that the review process is completed.
acceptance: Given approved feedback, When the system posts it to Basecamp, Then the review is marked 'Completed'.
Given a posting error, When the system retries, Then it eventually succeeds or logs an error.
Trust: The system logs posting events with feedback ID and status.
stories.task_guidance: Implement feedback posting logic using Basecamp's REST API, ensuring retries on failure.

stories.title: Preserve Review History
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to preserve review history, so that audits can be conducted on AI drafts and human edits.
acceptance: Given a completed review, When the system archives it, Then both AI drafts and human edits are preserved.
Given an audit request, When the system retrieves history, Then it shows all relevant actions and timestamps.
Trust: The system logs all archival events with review ID.
stories.task_guidance: Develop archival logic to store AI drafts and human edits separately in the database.

stories.title: Handle Ambiguous Identifications
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to handle ambiguous project or Stress Test identifications, so that I can route them to manual resolution.
acceptance: Given an ambiguous project ID, When the system processes it, Then it routes to manual resolution.
Given an ambiguous Stress Test ID, When the system processes it, Then it routes to manual resolution.
Trust: The system logs all manual resolution events with details.
stories.task_guidance: Implement logic to detect and route ambiguous identifications to a manual resolution queue.

stories.title: Implement Error Handling for External Calls
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to handle errors in external API calls, so that I can maintain system stability.
acceptance: Given an API call failure, When the system retries, Then it succeeds or logs an error after bounded attempts.
Given a network issue, When the system detects it, Then it surfaces a visible error state.
Trust: The system logs all API call attempts and outcomes.
stories.task_guidance: Develop error handling logic for external API calls, ensuring retries and error logging.

stories.title: Prepare for Future Stress Test Modules
stories.narrative: As a system, I want to support adding new Stress Test modules, so that I can extend functionality without rebuilding.
acceptance: Given a new Stress Test module, When the system loads it, Then it integrates without core changes.
Given a configuration error, When the system detects it, Then it logs an error for resolution.
Trust: The system logs all module loading events with module ID.
stories.task_guidance: Design system architecture to support modular addition of new Stress Test configurations.

stories.title: Implement Trust Spine for Submission Processing
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want an audit trail for all submission processing actions, so that I can ensure compliance and traceability.
acceptance: Given a submission is processed, when an action is taken, then it is logged in the audit trail.
Given a submission is processed without human review, when the system attempts to auto-approve, then it blocks the action.
Trust: The system ensures no credentials are stored in source code or shared documents.
stories.task_guidance: Implement logging for all actions in submission processing. Ensure human review is mandatory before approval. Verify no credentials are hardcoded or stored insecurely.

stories.title: Web UI for Review Queue Management
stories.narrative: As a reviewer, I want a web UI to manage the Review Queue, so that I can efficiently perform and track reviews.
acceptance: Given a pending review in the queue, when accessed via the UI, then it displays all necessary details for review.
Given a completed review, when accessed via the UI, then it shows the review status and history.
Trust: The system logs all UI interactions with timestamps and user IDs.
failure_paths: UI fails to load review details
Review status not updated in UI
stories.task_guidance: Develop a web interface for reviewers to access and manage the Review Queue. Ensure all actions are logged for audit purposes.
